The evidence also shows 11 payments require customer 3-D Secure action, so I’ll escalate those and won’t report all 143 as settled.

item.text:
INC-4471 is closed with **completion unverified**: checkout is healthy in both zones, and certificate checks remain enabled. The cause was zone B’s stale trust bundle after the provider rotated its intermediate certificate.

All 143 orders remain present. **132 payments are settled** with matching local records and no duplicate charges. **11 remain unpaid** until customers complete 3-D Secure; Payments Ops acknowledged the escalation and will send re-authorization emails after 10:00. The customer update therefore says 132 of 143 payments are settled and describes the remaining action.
